title: 360° B2B Revenue-Leak, Passive OSINT, GEO & Contact Enricher
description: Zero-cognitive-load B2B prospecting. Type a niche + city OR paste domains. We do the rest: tech-stack, ad-pixel leaks, GEO/llms.txt readiness, DNS/DMARC & security headers, decision-maker contacts, deal-value scoring, and a ready-to-send cold email — per lead, automatically.

searchKeyword.title: 🔍 1. Just type what you're looking for (Zero-URL Mode)
searchKeyword.description: Plain English works best, e.g. "MedSpas in Austin" or "Roofing contractors in Dallas". Leave empty if you're pasting your own URLs below.

urls.title: 🌐 2. ...OR paste your own domains / URLs
urls.description: One domain or URL per line. If filled, this takes priority over the search keyword for those exact sites.

agencyFocus.title: 🎯 3. What kind of agency are you? (customizes the pitch & cold email)
agencyFocus.description: We tailor whatToPitch, estDealValue and oneClickColdEmail to the service you sell.
enumTitles: 🧩 All-in-One / Not sure yet (show every gap)
📈 Paid Ads / SMMA (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads)
agencyFocus.sectionDescription: This changes nothing about the data we collect — only how the pitch, deal value and cold email are worded.

maxResults.title: 🔢 Max leads to return
maxResults.description: Maximum number of enriched companies to output in this run. Keep it small while testing.
maxResults.sectionDescription: Fine-tune speed, depth and cost. Defaults work great for most users.

crawlContactPages.title: 🕵️ Deep-crawl Contact / About / Team pages (2-Hop Crawler)
crawlContactPages.description: Finds up to 2 extra high-value pages per site (/contact, /about, /team, /support, /impressum) to extract 3x more decision-maker emails, phones and social profiles. Adds ~1-3s per lead.

maxSearchQueriesPerKeyword.title: 🔎 Search depth (only used in Search Keyword mode)
maxSearchQueriesPerKeyword.description: How many DuckDuckGo query variations to run to discover enough clean business domains (directories like Yelp/Facebook/LinkedIn are auto-filtered out).

requestTimeoutSecs.title: ⏱️ Per-request timeout guard (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: A slow or dead site will never hang the run — we give up on any single request after this many seconds and move on.

proxyConfiguration.title: 🌍 Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Recommended for larger runs / Search Keyword mode to avoid rate-limits. Works great with Apify's default datacenter proxies.

webhookUrl.title: 🔗 Push every lead live to Clay / Make / n8n (optional)
webhookUrl.description: Paste a webhook URL and we'll POST each enriched lead the instant it's ready — zero manual CSV downloading. Leave empty to skip.
webhookUrl.sectionDescription: Optional real-time push so your automations run without you lifting a finger.
